game_concept: A adventure race set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Well, a frozen village well: the hold guard must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Library Builder: Combine small functions into a reusable library the hold guard calls throughout the level.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Well: a frozen village well
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Well, repeat each round: Combine small functions into a reusable library the hold guard calls throughout the level. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the hold guard ahead. Then check the library value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the wall banner by solving code steps involving library that move the hold guard forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.15).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the wall banner first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 8 (extended tier): Library Builder
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Library Builder' (Week 6 slot 14), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Frozen Well'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how library changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Frozen Well.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.15).
